UPLOAD_TOKEN.description: Secret token used by the web UI and capture clients to upload, list and delete images. Generate a random one with `openssl rand -hex 32` and keep it to yourself — anyone holding it can upload to your instance.

BUCKET.description: R2 bucket where your image files are stored. Only your Cloudflare account can read it.

DB.description: D1 database holding image metadata (id, content type, size, created at).

MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES.description: Maximum accepted upload size in bytes. Defaults to `20971520` (20MiB).
